sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: MIDI is read as the third minimarket chain: a 77%-parent-controlled, 14%-float, low-margin rollup whose 2023 rights issue diluted holders, whose Lawson foray lost money, and whose growth is capex-hungry. The market reads the 2023-24 de-rating as structural.

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
| IDR bn | FY2024A | FY2025A | FY2026E | FY2027E | FY2028E |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 19,888.1 | 20,642.2 | 22,500 | 24,345 | 26,171 |
| EBIT (LK) | 719.2 | 968.0 | 1,073 | 1,186 | 1,301 |
| Net income | 546.4 | 792.4 | 815 | 936 | 1,034 |
| EPS (IDR) | 16.34 | 23.70 | 24.4 | 28.0 | 30.9 |
| DPS (IDR) | 7.35 | 11.85 | 12.2 | 14.0 | 15.5 |

**Revenue.** 9M26 Rp16,676.3bn, +9.17% (F34/F17); Q4-26 at +8.5% gives FY2026E +9.0%. The 200-store plan (F9) sits on 2,627 stores (F8), but Q1 added 40 (F8); growth tapers to +6.2% by FY2030E.

**Margin.** Gross margin was 26.14% FY2025 and 26.17% 9M26; I hold it flat — food grows fastest (+11.58%, F19), fresh food flat, so higher-margin blocks are not gaining. Opex (S&D + G&A − other income) was 20.74% in 9M26 (F35/F36/F37), but Q4-25 alone ran 24.0% (gross profit 1,449.1 less EBIT 160.4 on revenue 5,367.2), so I do not annualise nine months: FY2026E 21.4%, then −10bp a year. EBIT is Rp1,073bn (4.77%), not the ~5.4% the nine-month run-rate implies.

**Below EBIT.** D&A 4.4% (FY2025 4.56%), net interest −35/−30/−25, tax 19% (FY2025 17.7%, normalised), EPS on 33,435.3m shares, DPS at the 50% payout (F14/F16). FY2025 net carries a Q4-25 non-operating gain (PBT Rp246.5bn vs EBIT Rp160.4bn), so FY2026E net growth is +2.9% headline, ~+13% clean.

**Owner earnings and returns.** FY2025 CFO Rp1,657.2bn (F45) less cash capex Rp1,141.9bn = FCF Rp515.3bn; NI−CFO over assets −9.5%: accruals clean. Maintenance capex is D&A Rp941.7bn (F3), growth Rp200.2bn; the segment note's Rp1,493.6bn (F29) is gross, including Rp363.9bn non-cash ROU (F28). Reinvestment is 6.66% capex less 4.4% D&A = 2.26% of sales against a 3.8% NOPAT margin, a ~59% rate; at 15% ROIIC that funds 8.9% growth. The Rp7.5bn-per-store reading overstates new-store capex: D&A per store of Rp364m implies a ~Rp2.5-3bn asset.

**Fade and terminal.** Excess returns fade by year 10. Terminal g 3.1% is CPI (3.28% FY2027E deck) with no real growth; terminal ROIIC 14%, above the 11.5% WACC on outside-Java density but below the 20%+ the 2023-25 recovery printed, which the Lawson exit flattered. Implied exit is 4.1x EBITDA vs 4.3x entry and a 5.37x peer median — no multiple expansion.

**Valuation.** DCF Rp266 (WACC 11.5%, g 3.1%) at 60%, 9.1x FY2027E EPS 28.0 = Rp255 at 25%, 4.5x FY2027E EBITDA 2,257 (below the 5.37x median) = Rp293 at 15%: base Rp267. Sensitivity: ±50bp EBIT margin ±Rp35; WACC 11-12% Rp312-272; g 2.1-4.1% ±Rp30. Terminal value is 74% of EV, above the house's 53.6%.

sections.heading: EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate
sections.markdown: Accruals clean. **Other income** Rp230.8bn (F38) is 24% of LK EBIT Rp968.0bn (F1), recurring but non-operating; a 50% haircut costs ~Rp30/share. **Related party:** Rp203.9bn of distribution to PT Trimitra Trans Persada is 49.67% of the line (F49/F50), purchases 1.59% (F51/F52), management fee Rp5.3bn (F53) — disclosed, but a governance discount is warranted. **IDX regime:** no pemantauan khusus; shares constant since the July 2023 rights issue (F55). **Leases:** PSAK 73 liabilities Rp680.8bn (F32) treated as debt, ROU additions in capex. **Data defect:** the dossier's EBIT Rp763.8bn excludes net other income; LK profit from operations is Rp968.0bn (F1); I use LK basis.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the 2023 rights issue (4,611.8m shares, Rp1,233bn net, F55/F57) funded a capex-hungry rollout; Lawson proved it does not travel; with retail sales at 1.3% (F24), MIDI cannot earn its cost of capital, and 77.09% parent control (F22) leaves minorities without a remedy.
**Why wrong:** the operating record contradicts saturation. 9M26 revenue +9.17% and EBIT +18.4% (F34/F40) lifted the EBIT margin to 5.44% from 5.02%, with the loss-maker gone and negative working capital part-funding the rollout. The de-rating is a dilution and sentiment hangover, not a unit-economics failure; ROIIC is mid-teens versus 11.5% WACC.
**What proves us wrong:** FY2026 EBIT margin fails to hold 4.5%, gross margin falls below 25.5%, or net store adds drop under 150 with revenue growth under 6%.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Other income Rp230.8bn (F38) is 24% of LK EBIT Rp968.0bn (F1); strip it and the FY2025 operating margin is 3.6%, not 4.7%.
2. Q4-25 EBIT was Rp160.4bn on Rp5,367.2bn revenue, a 3.0% margin (datapack 2025Q4; 9M26 in F40); a repeat leaves FY2026 EBIT near Rp1,070bn.
3. Real retail sales grew 1.3% yoy in August 2026 (F24) against MIDI's +9.17% (F17): the gap is share gain and price, not industry growth.
4. Distribution bought from PT Trimitra Trans Persada was Rp203.9bn, 49.67% of the line (F49/F50); affiliate pricing can take margin minorities cannot control.
5. Capex was Rp1,493.6bn gross in FY2025 (F29), ~Rp1,500bn planned for 2026 (F10), 6.66% of sales; my FY2026E FCF of Rp393bn does not cover the Rp408bn dividend — the payout is not self-funded that year.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029; the position lost 30%. The likely reason is a structural de-rating: Kopdes Merah Putih and Alfamart/Indomaret density capped same-store sales, MIDI kept opening stores into a 1-2% market, capex stayed above 6% of sales, FCF never covered the dividend, the board cut the payout, and the multiple stayed at 4x EBITDA. The second is governance: affiliate distribution pricing took the margin the minority underwrote. The third is accounting: the Rp230bn other income was not operating and faded, taking ~2pp off the margin.

sections.heading: IDX microstructure, macro stance and levels
sections.markdown: Free float is 14.24% against the exchange's 15% minimum due 2027-03-31; AMRT holds 77.09%, institutions 4.1%, and MSCI's Standalone consultation runs to mid-2027; the name is not HSC-listed. Three-month ADTV is Rp2.22bn, no zero-volume days; a Rp10bn position is ~23 sessions at 20% participation; the 25% ARB band at Rp248 means a kill exit can gap toward Rp153. Macro stance NEUTRAL: staples minimarkets are not the AVOID rate-sensitive discretionary sleeve, but 1.3% retail-sales growth and rupiah pressure leave no consumption tailwind. Levels: entry Rp226 (0.85x base 267, the float/governance discount), target Rp268 (base value, tick-rounded), kill Rp204 (the 4.0% FY2027 EBIT-margin case). At Rp248 the EV is negative; own it only at 226. Kelly at p 0.40, b 2.96: own 19.8% full / 5.0% quarter; library b 1.67: 4.0% / 1.0%.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: The v2 model answers the card's three questions: capex is 6.66% (Rp1,500bn), the FY2026E EBITDA margin is 9.17% with a −8bp calibration gap, and the terminal exit is 4.6x EBITDA against a 5.37x peer median. On the operating lines we agree: the model's FY2026E EBIT is Rp1,075bn, mine Rp1,073bn. The gap is valuation: the house runs ten explicit years to FY2035 and terminal ROIIC near double the 11.5% WACC, producing Rp344 and a Rp343 target; I fade by year five at terminal ROIIC 14%, producing Rp267 and a Rp268 target. The report calls terminal ROIC its most aggressive call. I will not underwrite double-WACC returns a decade out for a replicable format facing the Kopdes rollout. That, not near-term cash flow, is the disagreement.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. [FATAL] Payoff mis-set before probability: at 226, target 268 + 16.2 carry − 1.5 drag = 33.3% / 3y = 10.06%/yr — under the 10.44% hurdle at p_up 1.0. Rp272 was needed; your base is 267.
2. [FATAL] Sub-hurdle at every executable price. EV 6.6%/3y = 2.15%/yr. With target 268 and kill 204, 34.7% needs entry Rp177 — below your own kill. At 204: 17.5%; at 248: −2.4%.
3. [FATAL] The down leg is a stop, not a scenario: −9.7% uses the kill while upside uses base 267, not the 440 bull. Your bear is 156 (−31%); the archetype base_down is −30%. On that leg EV at 226 is −6.2%.
4. [FATAL] 5.44% 9M26 margin does not reconcile. Dossier quarters total 834.4 on 16,676.3 = 5.00%. 5.44% (907) implies 9M26 other income 72.8 vs ~163 in 9M25 — a 55% fall in the line you capitalise at 231 in perpetuity. If 73 holds, FY2026E EBIT ~1,000 (4.4%) and the 4.2% kill nearly trips.
5. [MATERIAL] 226 = 0.85 × 267, tick-rounded, not derived from tape or valuation. The float/governance premium is the 1% COE add (coc.coe_premium); 0.85 charges it twice. At 248 EV is −2.4%: the trade is the multiplier.
6. [MATERIAL] 14% terminal ROIIC is unsourced and outside the house sensitivity surface (lowest print 287). The claimed 248→267 mispricing (7.7%) is inside your own ±Rp35 band: a haircut, not an edge. The house at 343 is more bullish: the variant is fade length, not information.
7. [MATERIAL] 14.24% float against a 15% minimum due 2027-03-31 is uncited. If true, ~254m shares (~Rp63bn, ~28 ADTV sessions) must clear above your entry in five months; catalyst_date is null; 226, a 9% placement discount, does not quantify it.
8. [MATERIAL] Kill 204 is a price stop: −9.7% in a 0.74-beta, 25%-ARB name fires before the 4.2% KPI can falsify anything. ARB gap fills realise −25/−35%, which down_pct ignores. Keep the KPI, drop the price exit.
9. [MINOR] b 2.96 ≠ 18.6/9.7 = 1.92; it reproduces the Rp293 EBITDA cross-check, not the committed 268. At b 1.92 Kelly is 8.7% full / 2.2% quarter, not 19.8/5.0 — 2.3x overstated.
10. [MINOR] Integrity: draft→phase2 in 14m38s for a 57-fact DCF; priors recite document facts (77.09%, 14.24%, 2023 rights issue); p_up equals the registry 0.40 exactly, while that entry requires an intact competitive position that falling revenue/store and flat LFL contradict. Flagged for QC.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** Strongest sentence: at the committed Rp226 the thesis returns 10.06%/yr even if it is certain to work, so the payoff, not the probability, already fails the hurdle — and on an honest 30% down leg the expected value is negative.
**Stop objecting:** none on the committed structure — at the kill (204) EV is still 17.5% against 34.7%. Rp223 is the entry at which a certain win clears 10.44%/yr; the fix is a higher target or an honest down leg, not a lower price.
